verdict.rationale: Formant documents several APIs and SDKs (Admin API, query API, ingestion API, Agent and Cloud SDKs), so this axis applies to the product. Nothing in the evidence shows API versioning or a documented deprecation policy. A doc page labelled "legacy" (mouse click stream) is not a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
